scripts.text:
[Catherine]
? Excuse me, I am wondering if we have met before...?
Hey~ you have changed a lot! So, what happened?
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
咦？不好意思，我們以前是不是見過...？
嘿~你變化真大！發生了什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I feel you have become so much powerful, eh?
Congratulations and good luck with your life!
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
感覺你變強了好多呢？
恭喜，祝你今後一切順利！

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Since you're already a Wizard, you don't have any more business with me...?
Now, excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
既然你已經是巫師了，應該沒有事找我了吧...？
那麼，失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Well, If you intended to ask me on a date... I appreciate it...hohoho.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
嗯，要是想約我出去...我很高興哦...呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Well, if you fix me up with a cute guy... I'd appreciate it...hohoho!.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
嗯，要是能給我介紹個帥哥...我會很感激的...呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Wizard Guildsman]
Oh my goodness, it's a novice~ ain't you the cutest little thing.
By the way honey, this place is for Wizards.
scripts.translation:
[巫師公會成員]
天哪，是初心者~真是個可愛的小傢伙。
不過，親愛的，這裡是巫師公會。

scripts.text:
[Wizard Guildsman]
If you are interested in magic,
Go visit the ^0000FFMage^000000 guild.
scripts.translation:
[巫師公會成員]
對魔法感興趣的話，就去^0000FF魔法師^000000公會吧。

scripts.text:
[Wizard Guildsman]
Huh? what brings you to such a high place...?
If you don't have any specific business, please leave immediately.
This place is for Wizards, you know?
scripts.translation:
[巫師公會成員]
咦？你怎麼爬到這麼高的地方來了...？
沒什麼特別的事，就請馬上離開。
這裡可是巫師公會哦？

scripts.text:
[Wizard Guildsman]
Ok, then. Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[巫師公會成員]
好吧。再見。

scripts.text:
[Wizard Guildsman]
Huh? What are you doing way up here...?
So what brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[巫師公會成員]
咦？你爬到這麼高的地方來做什麼...？
有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: I want to become a Wizard.
scripts.translation: 我想成為巫師

scripts.text: ...nothing.
scripts.translation: ...沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Wizard Guildsman]
I see... Well, of course you want to become a Wizard, otherwise you wouldn't have walked up all those stairs right?
Anyways, I would like to welcome you. I will assist you in becoming a Wizard.
scripts.translation:
[巫師公會成員]
原來如此...當然是想成為巫師，不然也不會爬那麼多樓梯上來，對吧？
總之，歡迎你，我會幫你轉職為巫師。

scripts.text:
[Wizard Guildsman]
My name is Catherine Medici. Just between me and you, I just became a Wizard too!
You can call me Cathy if you want. Hehehehehe~
scripts.translation:
[巫師公會成員]
我叫凱瑟琳·美第奇。
悄悄告訴你，我也剛成為巫師！
叫我凱西也可以哦，呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Many people want to become Wizards, but only the patient and strong ones will eventually accomplish their goals.
In order to become a Wizard, one must undergo difficult quests.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
想成為巫師的人很多，但最終能如願的，只有耐心又強大的人。
要成為巫師，必須完成艱難的任務。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Also only mages who have reached a job level of 40 or higher are qualified for these quests.
Lower level mages aren't experienced enough with magic to become Wizards...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
而且，只有職業等級達到40級的魔法師，才有資格參加這些任務。
等級不夠的魔法師，魔法經驗還不足以成為巫師...

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Well, I will give you more information when you apply for the job.
So! Do you want to apply now?
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
申請轉職時，我會詳細說明。
那麼！現在要申請嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，我要申請

scripts.text: On second thought, Let me think about it.
scripts.translation: 還是讓我再想想

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Hey hey, weren't you listening to me?
I told you that you need to be at least job level 40 to sign up for the quest...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
喂喂，剛才沒聽我說話嗎？
我說過，職業等級至少要達到40級，才能報名參加任務...

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
No need to hurry, go experience and ponder more about the world of magic.
When I deem you're qualified, I will accept your application.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
不用急，再去探索魔法世界，多積累些見識吧。
等你夠資格了，我會受理你的申請。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Umm... You're well qualified, but you have some unused skill points left.
You'd better learn more skills before applying again.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
嗯...資格是夠了，但你還有沒用完的技能點。
先把技能學好，再來申請吧。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Very well then, I accept your application.
Your name is...{0}, isn't it? I am not sure if I pronounced it correctly?
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
好，我受理你的申請。
你叫...{0}，對吧？我沒念錯吧？

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
The Wizard job change quest is divided into 3 parts.
1st part, gathering magic items.
2nd part, a written test.
The last part is a practical magic test.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
巫師轉職任務分為三個部分。
第一部分，收集魔法物品。
第二部分，筆試。
最後一部分是魔法實操測試。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Among one of these tests, we exempt those who are at job level 50.
It is enough to prove to us the effort it will take to become a Wizard if a mage has learned that much already.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
職業等級達到50級，可以免去其中一項測試。
魔法師修行到這個程度，已經足以證明成為巫師的決心和付出的努力了。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Hmm, come to think of it, you're at job level 50!?
You must have worked very hard. Your going to become a very powerful Wizard, I can feel it in you.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
嗯，仔細一看，你的職業等級已經50級了！？
一定下了不少功夫吧。
我能感覺到，你會成為一名強大的巫師。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Ok. You already passed the 1st test then.
Don't get too laid back though, there are still 2 more tests left.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
好，那就算你通過第一項測試了。
不過，可別鬆懈，還有兩項測試呢。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Go talk to the man in the corner and he will give you the remaining exams.
Be careful. We have lost many Mages due to the difficulty of the exams.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
去找角落裡的那個男人，他負責接下來的考試。
小心點，考試太難，我們已經失去了不少魔法師。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Then, since I have your application and everything else I need, I'll give you some info about the first test.
You can memorize this or write it down, doesn't matter. But remember it for sure.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
申請和其他準備都齊了，我來說明第一項測試。
背下來也好，寫下來也好，總之一定要記住。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
The first test is collecting magic items.
The important part is that you must gather these items on your own.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
第一項測試是收集魔法物品。
關鍵在於，你必須親自收集。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
The items you must collect are...
^3355FFRed Gemstone^000000 10 each,
^3355FFBlue Gemstone^000000 10 each,
^3355FFYellow Gemstone^000000 10 each,
...is it too hard? No, any would be Wizard should be able to at least get these items.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
你要收集這些物品...
^3355FF紅色魔力礦石^00000010個，
^3355FF藍色魔力礦石^00000010個，
^3355FF黃色魔力礦石^00000010個，
...太難了？不會吧，想成為巫師，至少得能弄到這些東西。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
The items you must collect are...
^3355FFCrystal Blue^000000 5 each,
^3355FFGreen Live^000000 5 each,
^3355FFRed Blood^000000 5 each,
^3355FFWind of Verdure^000000 5 each,
...is it too hard? No, any would be Wizard should be able to at least get these items.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
你要收集這些物品...
^3355FF水靈原石^0000005個，
^3355FF土靈原石^0000005個，
^3355FF火靈原石^0000005個，
^3355FF風靈原石^0000005個，
...太難了？不會吧，想成為巫師，至少得能弄到這些東西。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Well, good luck.
I'll be happily waiting. ~Hehe.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
祝你好運。
我會滿懷期待地等著哦，~呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Oh, ok then, take your time.
Since I'll always be here, accepting applications...*sigh*...anyways! ~Hehehehe.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
哦，好吧，慢慢考慮。
反正我一直在這裡受理申請...*嘆氣*...總之！~呵呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Wizard Guildsman]
Geez, what a lame person.
You have no business here, hope you don't mind, now off you go!
scripts.translation:
[巫師公會成員]
真是的，真沒勁。
這裡沒你的事，別介意，快走吧！

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Let me see, did you get all the items?
Then let's check...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
讓我看看，東西都收齊了嗎？
來，檢查一下...

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Perfect! You got all the items. I like!~
These items will be put to great use in our guild. ~Hehehee.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
太好了！東西都齊了，真不錯！~
這些東西在公會裡能派上大用場，~呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Good for you! You passed the first test.
But there are still two more left, so don't get too relaxed.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
做得好！你通過了第一項測試。
但還有兩項，所以別太放鬆。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Go talk to the guy in the corner for the rest of the tests.
It might be a bit hard, so be careful, I wouldn't want you ending up like most of the Mages that come for these exams...poor souls indeed, may they rest in peace. ~Hehehe.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
去找角落裡的那個男人，參加剩下的測試。
可能有點難，要小心哦，我可不想你落得和大多數考生一樣的下場...
可憐的魔法師們，願他們安息。
~呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Hey, what's this? Umm...I don't think you have everything yet!
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
咦，怎麼回事？嗯...東西好像還沒收齊哦！

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
It might've been tough coming all the way up here, what with this altitude and all, but go back and collect the items.
Life's short enough as it is, so stop wasting your time and gather the items I told you before.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
這裡這麼高，爬上來是挺辛苦的，不過還是得回去收集物品。
人生本來就短，別浪費時間了，去收集我之前說的東西吧。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
^3355FFRed Gemstone^000000 10 each,
^3355FFBlue Gemstone^000000 10 each,
^3355FFYellow Gemstone^000000 10 each,
Don't forget this time, and bring all the items, ok?...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
^3355FF紅色魔力礦石^00000010個，
^3355FF藍色魔力礦石^00000010個，
^3355FF黃色魔力礦石^00000010個，
這次別忘了，要全部帶齊，好嗎？...

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Did you get all the items?
Let's see... Do you have the right ones?...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
東西都收齊了嗎？
讓我看看...有沒有帶錯？...

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Perfect! Good job...I'm satisfied! ~Hehe
Our guild greatly appreciates these items and will use them wisely.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
太好了！幹得不錯...我很滿意！~呵呵
公會很感謝你帶來的這些物品，會好好利用它們。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Good. You've passed the first test now.
But you still have two more tests to go, so don't get too laid back, because it only gets harder from here. ~Hehehe
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
很好，第一項測試通過了。
不過還有兩項，可別鬆懈，接下來只會更難。
~呵呵呵

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Go talk to that guy in the corner to take the rest of the tests.
It might be a bit hard, so be careful, I wouldn't want you ending up like most of the Mages that come for these exams...poor souls indeed, may they rest in peace. ~Hehehe.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
去找角落裡的那個人，參加剩下的測試。
可能有點難，要小心哦，我可不想你落得和大多數考生一樣的下場...
可憐的魔法師們，願他們安息。
~呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Eh, what's this? I don't think you have everything?
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
咦，怎麼回事？東西好像還沒收齊？

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I regret that you had to go through the trouble of coming all the way up here, but go get the right items again.
Stop wasting your time and get the items I initially requested. For goodness sakes...This is the easiest part of the exam.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
不好意思，讓你辛苦爬上來，不過還得再去收集正確的物品。
別浪費時間了，把我一開始要求的東西帶來。
真是的...這可是考試裡最簡單的部分。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
^3355FFCrystsal Blue^000000 5 each,
^3355FFGreen Live^000000 5 each,
^3355FFRed Blood^000000 5 each,
^3355FFWind of Verdure^000000 5 each,
Don't forget them this time and gather the correct ones, ok? See you soon...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
^3355FF水靈原石^0000005個，
^3355FF土靈原石^0000005個，
^3355FF火靈原石^0000005個，
^3355FF風靈原石^0000005個，
這次別忘了，物品也別弄錯，好嗎？回頭見...

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
What is it? You didn't go talk to the guy in the corner?
You can't become a Wizard by just brining the items I requested, no no, that just wont do...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
怎麼了？沒去找角落裡的那個人？
光帶來我要求的物品，可成不了巫師，不行不行...

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
You can only prove yourself Wizard material after you take the two remaining tests.
I'll be waiting, so go now.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
參加完剩下的兩項測試，才能證明你有成為巫師的資質。
我會在這裡等著，快去吧。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
*sigh*...Poor thing, what a pity.
How can you think of trying to become a Wizard when you can't even answer those simple questions?
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
*嘆氣*...可憐，真可惜。
連那麼簡單的問題都答不上來，還怎麼成為巫師呢？

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Let's see... Should I give you some hints as your senior?
But I'm a bit thirsty, so give me 1 Apple Juice, and we got a deal. ~Hehehe
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
嗯...作為前輩，要不要給你點提示呢？
不過我有點渴，給我1瓶蘋果汁，就這麼說定了。
~呵呵呵

scripts.text: Give me some hints, please.
scripts.translation: 請給我一些提示

scripts.text: I want to try again on my own!
scripts.translation: 我想自己再試一次！

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Yummers, Apple Juice is the best...
Gulp gulp gulp... Haaaaaah... ~Hehe
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
好喝，蘋果汁最棒了...
咕嘟咕嘟咕嘟...哈啊...~呵呵

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Well then, I'll give you a hint for the second test.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
那麼，給你一些第二項測試的提示。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
He asks three types of questions.
Questions about Magic, Monsters...
and Magicians...also known as Mages.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
他會問三類問題：魔法、魔物...還有魔法師。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
It's up to him to decide which questions to ask.
*sigh*...He'd look much better if he cut his hair and shaved...
He always looks so grungy because he doesn't take care of himself...*sigh*...pity, he could be a regular lady killer. ~tehehehe
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
問哪些題，全由他決定。
*嘆氣*...要是剪剪頭髮、刮刮鬍子，肯定好看多了...
他就是不打理自己，才總那麼邋遢...*嘆氣*...真可惜，本來能迷倒一大群姑娘呢。
~呵呵呵呵

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Anyways, as for the questions about magic...
They're usually about the spells you've learned.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
總之，魔法方面的題...通常都是你學過的法術。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
If it's something you haven't learned or haven't experienced, or anything like that...
I heard there's a nice place you can refer to that's very well organized.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
要是遇到沒學過、沒接觸過的內容...
聽說有個地方的資料整理得很清楚，可以去查查。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
You just have to cast the spell, you know...the one that looks like a big bold *e* symbol.
The magic words are... iro.ragnarokonline.com ~Or so they say!
Strange spell, don't you think? I don't know how to make it work myself.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
只要施放那個法術...就是像一個又大又粗的*e*符號的那個。
咒語是...iro.ragnarokonline.com~至少大家都這麼說！
很奇怪的法術吧？我自己也不知道怎麼用。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
And about the monster questions.
Fighting them yourself and learning is the best way to go about that.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
至於魔物方面的題，親自和它們戰鬥、積累經驗，是最好的辦法。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
But you know in Prontera, there is a big library.
You can get information about most of the monsters in that library.
Going there and studying a bit more would work too.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
不過，普隆德拉有座大圖書館。
那裡能查到大多數魔物的資料。
去那兒多研究研究也行。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Last, but not least, questions about Mages.
This is something that most others cannot teach you...
Because you are a Mage.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
最後，是同樣重要的魔法師方面的題。
這可不是別人能教你的...因為你自己就是魔法師。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
It's hard to know about others when you don't even know about yourself, right?
So if you get one of these questions, think about it carefully then answer.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
如果你連自己都不瞭解，又怎麼了解別人呢，對吧？
所以如果你遇到這類問題，請仔細思考後再回答。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Like I said, I'll think about it if you give me 1 Apple Juice.
If not... Well, you can think about it on your own. Hey I don't make the rules here i just follow em! Can't argue with this one though. ~tehehehe
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
我說過，給我1瓶蘋果汁，我就考慮幫你。
不然...就靠你自己想吧。
嘿，規矩不是我定的，我只是照辦！這條可沒得商量。
~呵呵呵呵

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Yeah, you get the most satisfaction when you solve things on your own.
Go finish the rest of the tests with that spirit!
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
沒錯，靠自己解決問題，才最有成就感。
帶著這股勁，去完成剩下的測試吧！

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Well then, see you soon! *crosses fingers* dont end up like the others before you! May God rest thier souls...huh? Oh nothing! ~Hehehehe
Hurry, he's waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
那就回頭見！*交叉手指*可別落得和之前那些人一樣的下場！
願上帝讓他們的靈魂安息...嗯？哦，沒什麼！~呵呵呵呵
快去，他在等你！

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Tehehehe~ I was listening all along.
Well done in answering all those questions. I want to give something, like a present...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
呵呵呵呵~我一直在聽哦。
那些題答得很好，想送你點東西，當作禮物...

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
You still have one more test to go, right?
Just a bit more and you will be qualified to be a Wizard, so I'll give you the present then. ~Hehe
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
還有一項測試，對吧？
再努力一點，你就有資格成為巫師了，到時再給你禮物。
~呵呵

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
See ya, well...hopefully!
He's waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
回頭見，嗯...希望還能見到你！
他在等你呢！

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Eh, did you leave in the middle of the test?
You...*sigh*...I didn't think you would do such a dishonorable thing.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
呃，你是在測試中途離開的嗎？
你...*嘆氣*...我沒想到你會做出這麼不光彩的事。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Don't pretend to be weak just because you're a girl. Look at me! I did it, and so can you. You can't ask for sympathy.
You came all this way to become a Wizard! Now come on, you can do it!!
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
別因為是女孩子就裝弱。
看看我！我做到了，你也能做到，不能光指望別人同情。
你一路走到這裡，不就是為了成為巫師嗎！加油，你能行！！

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Granted you're a mage, but how could a guy be so weak?!
Well, at least your alive still. Go back and try harder this time. ~tehehehe
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
雖說是魔法師，一個男人也不能這麼弱吧？！
不過，至少還活著。
回去再試，這次要更努力哦。
~呵呵呵呵

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I agree that it is difficult, but not to the point of giving up.
You of all people should find the strength and patience to complete this test!
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
我承認測試很難，但還沒到非放棄不可的地步。
尤其是你，更該拿出力量和耐心，把測試完成！

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
So, try harder this time...
He's waiting!
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
所以，這次再努力一點...
他在等你了！

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Hey, what don't you get it?
I said you must be at least job level 40 to change your job, got it?
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
喂，還沒聽懂嗎？
我說過，職業等級至少要達到40級才能轉職，明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
There is nothing to be in hurry, so why don't you take your time for studying?
When the time comes, I will welcome you with open arms.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
不用急，慢慢學習就好。
等時機到了，我一定熱烈歡迎你。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Are you done with all the tests? Oh drats, it seems like you still have some skill points left.
Learn some other skills with your remaining points, and then come talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
測試都完成了？哎呀，好像還有沒用完的技能點。
先用剩下的點數學好技能，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Wooooooooooooow...you finished all the tests?!
Congratulations, congrats, congrats! Wooopiiieeeee! ~Hehehehehehe
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
哇啊啊啊...所有測試都完成了？！
恭喜，恭喜，恭喜！太棒啦！~呵呵呵呵呵

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Well, no need to wait, I congratulate you. I hearby deem you Wizard.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
那就不必再等了，恭喜你！
我在此宣佈，你正式成為巫師了。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Since you're a Wizard now, act like a Wizard, got it?
Us wizards have to be careful since we possess the ultimate power of magic.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
既然成了巫師，言行就得有巫師的樣子，明白嗎？
我們掌握著魔法的終極力量，必須謹慎行事。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Don't go about casting spells in town for no reason, or bother others with spells that are in their own battle.
A Wizard's magic is meant for their own battles with monsters.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
別無緣無故在城裡施法，也別用法術干擾別人的戰鬥。
巫師的魔法，是用來對付自己面對的魔物的。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Go join parties with others and keep training.
And...oh, wait, I prepared a present for you, one sec.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
去和大家組隊，繼續修行吧。
還有...啊，等等，我準備了份禮物，稍等一下。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
rummage rummage...
shuffle shuffle...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
rummage rummage...
shuffle shuffle...

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Here you go. I hope you'll make good use of it when you need it. ~tehehe
I gave them to you as a present, so don't go out and sell it. Use it for yourself, ok?
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
給你，需要的時候好好用哦。~呵呵
這是送你的禮物，可別拿去賣，留著自己用，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Well, then...*sight*...live a wonderful life as a Wizard, become the strongest out there!
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
那麼...*嘆氣*...作為巫師，活出精彩的人生，成為最強的巫師吧！

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
*Cough* *cough* what do you want?
If you are a person that uses magic, then you need to make sure you are well informed about it.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
*咳* *咳*找我幹什麼？
既然使用魔法，就必須充分了解魔法。

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Don't live dishonestly, or impolitely, or else one day you'll be caught in a spell you can't control, and BOOM, your dead!
If you don't want that to happen, then learn how to use spells properly!
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
做人別不誠實、沒禮貌，否則遲早會被自己控制不了的法術困住，然後砰的一聲，小命就沒了！
不想落得這下場，就學會正確使用法術！

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Don't live dishonestly, or impolitely, or else one day you'll be caught in a spell you can't control, and BOOM, your dead!
So learn how to use magic properly, or you would just be better off giving up on using magic.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
做人別不誠實、沒禮貌，否則遲早會被自己控制不了的法術困住，然後砰的一聲，小命就沒了！
所以，要學會正確使用魔法，不然還不如干脆放棄。

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
You may live life crippled if you get obsessed with the love of Greater Magic. ~haha
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
要是痴迷於強大的魔法，可能落得殘廢終生的下場。
~哈哈

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
If you don't want that, go hit on a guy or something! ~Hahahaha
If you don't pay attention to yourself, you'll be engulfed by magic one day...
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
不想那樣，就去找個男人談情說愛吧！~哈哈哈
不好好顧著自己，遲早會被魔法吞噬...

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Go away, one who works for the Church!
Magic repels Holy power, jeez...your messing up my aura.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
教會的人，走開！
魔法排斥神聖力量，真是的...你擾亂我的氣場了。

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
And plus, *cough* *cough* my health isn't all that good right now either...
Don't come any closer, just leave!
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
而且，*咳* *咳* 我現在的身體狀況也不太好...
別靠近了，快離開！

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Why did a little one like you come here?!
Get lost! ~Hahahahaha
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
像你這樣的小傢伙來這裡幹什麼？！
滾開！~哈哈哈

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
*sneeze* *cough* Oooowww...my entire body is in pain. I feel like I'm trapped in a tub of ice water!
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
*打噴嚏* *咳*哎喲...全身都疼。
簡直像被困在一缸冰水裡！

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
What do you want? Jeez...just get lost, won't you?
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
找我幹什麼？真是的...快走開，行不行？

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
*cough* *cough* *sneeze* I don't know who you are and what you do, but I don't have any business with you.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
*咳* *咳* *打噴嚏*我不知道你是誰，也不知道你做什麼，但我跟你沒什麼好說的。

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Go away! Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
走開！滾遠點！

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Hahahaha~ You're the one that wants to become a Wizard?!
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
哈哈哈~就是你想成為巫師？！

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
*sneeze* If you just lived as you were, all you'd have to do was hunt a little and live the easy life...
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
*打噴嚏*要是維持現狀，偶爾打打獵，就能過安穩日子了...

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
*Cough* *cough* Let's see how well you live as a Wizard. ~Hahahahhaha
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
*咳* *咳*我倒要看看，你當了巫師能過成什麼樣。
~哈哈哈哈

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
*Cough* *cough*...You must've passed the first test.
Ok, I'm the Wizard in charge of your testing from now on. My name is 'Raulel Asparagus'.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
*咳* *咳*...看來你通過第一項測試了。
從現在起，由我這個巫師負責你的考試。
我叫勞雷爾·阿斯帕拉格斯。

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
*sneeze* It's not too late yet, wouldn't you rather just go back to town and enjoy the peaceful life?
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
*打噴嚏*現在還來得及，回城過安穩日子不好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Hahahaha~ You don't know how dangerous it is...to deal with Greater Magic.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
哈哈哈~你根本不知道...駕馭強大的魔法有多危險。

scripts.text: I want to live as a normal Mage.
scripts.translation: 我想當個普通魔法師

scripts.text: I would like to continue with the tests.
scripts.translation: 我想繼續參加測試

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Hahaha~ *sneeze* Good choice...*cough* *cough*~
Best not to even dream about life as a Wizard. Graa...Greaa...*sneeze* Greater Magic wasn't meant for humans to use!
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
哈哈哈~*打噴嚏*選得好...*咳* *咳*~
最好連成為巫師的念頭都別有。
強...強大...*打噴嚏*強大的魔法，根本不是給人類用的！

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Leave the top of this tower quietly and don't ever look back.
Just live peacefully with the powers that you have right now.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
靜靜離開這座塔頂，別再回頭。
憑你現在的力量，安安穩穩地生活吧。

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
*sneeze* Hahahaha~ Now there's a foolish one here!
Well then, let's see how good you are. *cough* I want to see this with my own two eyes!
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
*打噴嚏*哈哈哈~還真有個傻瓜！
那就讓我看看你有多少本事。
*咳*我要親眼見識！

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
*sneeze* Then let's begin the test!
If you don't answer them all correctly, you fail. Hahahahahahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
*打噴嚏*開始測試！
不能全部答對，就算失敗。
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
I'll give you 10 questions so give me the right answers.
If you get something wrong, I won't tell you what it is!
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
我會問你10道題，要答對。
答錯了，我也不會告訴你錯在哪！

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
*Cough* *cough* Then here go the questions!
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
*咳* *咳*那麼，開始提問！

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Hahahaha~ Are you that desperate? *sneeze* What a pain in the arse...
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
哈哈哈~就這麼想當巫師？*打噴嚏*真麻煩...

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Since you don't want to settle for a stable and peaceful life, I'll give you another chance...
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
既然你不滿足於穩定平靜的生活，我再給你一次機會...

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
If you miss one single question, then just give up. You wouldn't have any talent in being a Wizard! ~Hahahahaha
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
哪怕只錯一道題，也趁早放棄吧。
那說明你根本沒有成為巫師的天賦！~哈哈哈

scripts.text: Because of you, I want to live as a normal Mage now.
scripts.translation: 聽你這麼說，我想當個普通魔法師了

scripts.text: I would like to continue with the tests.
scripts.translation: 我想繼續參加測試

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Hahahaha~ Surprising, comming from you, that's a very wise choice...*cough* *cough*
If i were you, i would never, ever dream of becoming a Wizard again. Gre...Greaa...*sneeze* Greater Magic wasn't meant for humans to use.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
哈哈哈~沒想到你也能做出這麼明智的選擇...*咳* *咳*
換作是我，絕不會再想成為巫師。
強...強大...*打噴嚏*強大的魔法，根本不是給人類用的。

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Just leave the top of this tower quietly and never look back.
Live peacefully with the powers that you have right now.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
靜靜離開這座塔頂，別再回頭。
憑你現在的力量，安安穩穩地生活吧。

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Hahahahahahaha~ Now there's a foolish one right here!
Well then, let's see just how good you can be! *sneeze* I want to see this with my own two eyes.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
哈哈哈哈哈哈~這裡還真有個傻瓜！
那就讓我看看你到底有多少本事！
*打噴嚏*我要親眼見識。

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Then let's begin the test!
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
那麼，讓我們開始測試吧！

scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
1. 以下哪項不是學習火焰之壁所必需的？

scripts.translation: 火狩 Lv 1

[勞雷爾]

1.7 times
2 times

scripts.translation: 紅色魔力礦石

scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
5. 以下哪項不是掌握暗之障壁所必需的？

scripts.translation: 心靈爆破 Lv 4

scripts.translation: 聖靈召喚 Lv 5

scripts.translation: 禪心 Lv 6

scripts.translation: 暗之障壁 Lv 7

[勞雷爾]
6. 學會禪心Lv 7後，不計智力加成，每10秒恢復多少SP？

[Raulel]

[勞雷爾]
7. 使用能量外套時，若剩餘SP為50%，受到攻擊會消耗多少SP，傷害會降低百分之幾？

scripts.translation: 傷害降低24%，SP消耗1.5%

scripts.translation: 傷害降低24%，SP消耗2%

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation: 35SP，6次

9. How much SP is needed when using Lv 10 Thunderstorm?

[勞雷爾]

[Raulel]

[勞雷爾]

2. Which of the following is the easiest monster for a low level Mage to hunt?

[勞雷爾]
2. 對於低等級魔法師來說，以下哪種魔物最容易狩獵？

scripts.translation: 巨石怪

scripts.translation: 麥斯特

[Raulel]
3. Which monster will not be affected by Stone Curse?
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
3. 哪種魔物不受石化術影響？

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Since your so weak that you can't finish this final test on your own...you need a separate test to help you out.
*Cough* If you can't pass the battle test, then do a good job with this one. Hahahahahahah~
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
你太弱，沒法獨自完成最後一項測試...只好另給你一項測試，幫你一把。
*咳*戰鬥測試過不了，就把這項做好吧。
哈哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Well, you better answer these problems if you plan on becoming a Wizard. Hahahahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
想成為巫師，就得答出這些題。
哈哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
1. Choose the monster with a different attribute than the others.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
1. 選擇屬性與其他三種不同的魔物。

scripts.text: Mantis
scripts.translation: 螳螂

scripts.text: Cornutus
scripts.translation: 卡那多斯

scripts.text: Giearth
scripts.translation: 基爾瑟

scripts.text: Caramel
scripts.translation: 刺蝟蟲

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
2. Choose the monster that is not a looting one.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
2. 選擇不會撿取地上物品的魔物。

scripts.text: Yoyo
scripts.translation: 溜溜猴

scripts.text: Magnolia
scripts.translation: 魔鍋蛋

scripts.text: Metaller
scripts.translation: 重金屬蝗蟲

scripts.text: Zerom
scripts.translation: 傑洛米

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
3. Which of these monsters does not recognize casting?
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
3. 以下哪種魔物不會對施法產生反應？

scripts.text: Marina
scripts.translation: 水母

scripts.text: Vitata
scripts.translation: 黑蟻

scripts.text: Scorpion
scripts.translation: 蠍子

scripts.text: Giearth
scripts.translation: 基爾瑟

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
4. Choose the spell that would be efficient against a Marine Sphere.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
4. 選出對氣泡蟲有效的法術。

scripts.text: Cold Bolt
scripts.translation: 冰箭術

scripts.text: Fire Bolt
scripts.translation: 火箭術

scripts.text: Lightning Bolt
scripts.translation: 雷擊術

scripts.text: Stone Curse
scripts.translation: 石化術

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
5. Choose the monster that can move.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
5. 選擇能夠移動的魔物。

scripts.text: Hydra
scripts.translation: 海葵

scripts.text: Madragora
scripts.translation: 曼陀羅魔花

scripts.text: Greatest General
scripts.translation: 將軍魔碑

scripts.text: Frilldora
scripts.translation: 傘蜥

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
*pfft* Do it right, so I don't have to ask again.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
*噗*好好答，別讓我再問一遍。

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
You got {0} points.
Hahahahahaha~ *Cough* *cough* If you can answer all these questions correctly, how is it you can't do well in battles??
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
你得了{0}分。
哈哈哈哈哈哈~*咳* *咳*這些題都答得對，怎麼一到戰鬥就不行了？？

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
You got {0} points.
Eh, soso...
I'll let you retake the test.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
你得了{0}分。
嗯，一般般...
我允許你重考。

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
You got {0} points.
You failed! Go study some more!
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
你得了{0}分。
不及格！回去多學學吧！

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
You lack something...*sneez*...like intelligence. That's why you keep on failing. Hahahahahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
你缺了點東西...*打噴嚏*...比如腦子。
所以才一直失敗，哈哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text: Begin the test please.
scripts.translation: 請開始測試

scripts.text: Can I get another explanation?
scripts.translation: 能再解釋一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Nobody is going to help you become a Wizard. Hahahahahahahaha~
*Cough* *cough* No point in crying after dying...
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
沒人會幫你成為巫師。哈哈哈哈哈哈~
*咳* *咳* 死了再哭也沒用...

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Then, as you wish. I'll send you to fight.
Oh! If you see some tall pearly gates and hear a booming deep voice from behind it, that means that your a failure when it comes to Magic. Hahahahahahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
如你所願，送你去戰鬥。
哦！要是看到高聳的珍珠大門，又聽見門後傳來低沉洪亮的說話聲，就說明你在魔法這條路上失敗了。
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
*Cough* *cough* Then I shall explain.
The test may be hard, but just do as I tell you and it shouldn't be a problem.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
*咳* *咳*那就說明一下。
測試可能很難，但照我說的做，應該沒問題。

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
There are 3 parts to this final test.
The order is...*sneez*...the Water Room, Earth Room, and then the Fire Room. Each room has monsters of that attribute in it.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
最後一項測試分為三個部分。
依次是...*打噴嚏*...水之房、地之房，最後是火之房。
每個房間都有對應屬性的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
You'll see what monsters they are when you enter.
If you use the appropriate spells against them, it shouldn't be that difficult. Hahahahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
進入房間後你就能看到是什麼魔物了。
如果對它們使用相應的法術，應該不會太難。哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Within the given time, if you defeat all the monsters...
you will be sent to the next room.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
在規定時間內消滅所有魔物...就會被送到下一個房間。

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
After that, the test is over.
You will then become a Wizard controlled by Greater Magic powers! There is no coming back to the easy life you have known thus far.
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
之後，測試就結束了。
你將成為受強大魔力支配的巫師！
從此再也回不到以前安逸的生活。

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Hahahahaha~ You look frightened. It's not too late you know.
*Cough* *cough* You can give up and go back to town! Just forget about the Greater Magic and live a normal life. What do yah say?
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
哈哈哈哈~看起來怕了？現在還來得及。
*咳* *咳*放棄吧，回城去！
忘了那些強大的魔法，過普通人的日子，怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Continue with the test.
scripts.translation: 繼續測試

scripts.text: I'm too scared, I would like to quit.
scripts.translation: 我太害怕了，想放棄

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
This time when you die, don't come back crying. Hahahahahahahahah~ *Cough *cough*
As you wish, let's begin the final test!
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
這次死了，可別哭著回來。
哈哈哈哈哈哈~*咳 *咳*
如你所願，開始最後一項測試！

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Comming from you, thats some darn good thinking. That's more a fit for you anyways. Hahahahahahahahaha~
Go back and live a quiet and peaceful life!
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
沒想到你也能做出這麼明智的選擇。
本來就這樣更適合你，哈哈哈哈哈哈~
回去過安穩日子吧！

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
You shouldn't have any more business with me as far as I'm concerned.
But, since your so darned persistent, I'll let you take the test again. Hahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
照理說，你已經沒什麼事該找我了。
不過，既然這麼執著，就再讓你考一次。
哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Raulel]
Go! Go and become the Wizard you really want to be.
And be careful! Greater Magic will always be after you...
scripts.translation:
[勞雷爾]
去吧！成為你一心想當的巫師！
小心，強大的魔法會一直追逐著你...

scripts.text:
[Arena Assistant]
Welcome to the Wizard Job Change Arena.
If you would like to take the final test, then please enter the waiting room.
scripts.translation:
[競技場助理]
歡迎來到巫師轉職競技場。
要參加最後一項測試，請進入候場室。

scripts.text:
[Arena Assistant]
If someone is already taking the test, please wait.
All testing status will be broadcasted, and will begin as soon as the previous tester has gone through.
scripts.translation:
[競技場助理]
如果有人正在測試，請耐心等待。
測試進度會隨時廣播，前一位考生完成後，就會開始下一場。

scripts.text:
[Arena Assistant]
Each person may take approximately 5 to 10 minutes.
If you would like to leave the arena, please log off anytime.
scripts.translation:
[競技場助理]
每位考生大約需要5到10分鐘。
想離開競技場，隨時退出遊戲即可。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
Instead of sticking around here, wouldn't it be better to go out and test how strong you've become?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
與其在這裡待著，不如出去試試你變得有多強？

scripts.text:
[Maria]
Don't forget that Wizards grow and improve in power each and every day.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
別忘了，巫師每天都在成長，力量也會不斷提升。

scripts.text:
[Dog]
What? Kiddo!
Is a Dog talking so amusing to you?
scripts.translation:
[狗]
什麼？小鬼！
一隻狗在說話，你覺得很有趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Sheesh...Why would a person that can't even cast a spell a single spell come up here?
*Pfft* If you're that bored, do the world a favor and climb to the top of this building via the outside, then proceed to do some acrobatics if you get there.
scripts.translation:
[狗]
真是的...連一個法術都不會，爬到這裡做什麼？
*噗*這麼無聊的話，就從外面爬到樓頂，再表演點雜技，也算給大家做點貢獻。

scripts.text:
[Dog]
*Bark* Get lost!
I don't have time for people like you!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
*汪* 走開！
我沒時間理你這種人！

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Ah...I know what you're about to say. You want to change jobs to a Wizard, right?
scripts.translation:
[狗]
啊...我知道你要說什麼。你想轉職成巫師，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Go talk to Catherine. She'll help you.
scripts.translation:
[狗]
去找凱瑟琳談談。她會幫你的。

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Also, if you would like to know anything about the job change process, I can explain.
scripts.translation:
[狗]
想了解轉職流程的話，我也可以說明。

scripts.text: A Dog is talking to me...
scripts.translation: 一隻狗在跟我說話...

scripts.text:
[Dog]
...*bark*...? What is it?? Why are you looking at me like that?!
Is it your first time seeing a Dog talk?
scripts.translation:
[狗]
...*汪*...？怎麼了？？你為什麼那樣看著我？！
你是第一次看到會說話的狗嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dog]
*Bark* It's not common that you see a Dog talking I suppose. bark~
...Yes i suppose it is a rare site...*grrr*...Stop Gawking for goodness sakes!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
*汪*會說話的狗，確實不常見吧，汪~
...嗯，確實挺稀奇...*低吼*...真是的，別盯著看了！

scripts.text:
[Dog]
My name is 'Maria Splodofska'. Just call me 'Maria'.
I'm helping candidates that wish to become Wizards.
scripts.translation:
[狗]
我叫瑪麗亞·斯普羅多夫斯卡，叫瑪麗亞就好。
我在幫助想成為巫師的人。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
*Bark* Well, the reason I became a dog is...I was helping my boyfriend in experimenting to prepare for his Final for his Magic Degree. Well, *Grrrr* he accidentally turned me into a dog.
Theoretically, in a couple months the chemicals should wear off and I should be returned to normal. When exactly, I have no idea?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
*汪*我為什麼變成狗...當時我在幫男朋友做實驗，準備他的魔法學位期末考試。
結果，*低吼*他不小心把我變成了狗。
理論上，過幾個月藥效消退，就能恢復原樣。
具體什麼時候，我也不知道。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
Well...it doesn't concern you anyways.
Now, where were we.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
嗯...反正這也不關你的事。
話說回來，我們剛才聊到哪了？

scripts.text:
[Dog]
*Bark* *bark* *bark* Don't state the obvious! Alright, I know I'm a dog!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
*汪* *汪* *汪*別說這種廢話！我當然知道自己是狗！

scripts.text:
[Dog]
My name is 'Maria Splodofska'. People call me 'Maria'.
I'm helping little ones like you that wish to become Wizards.
scripts.translation:
[狗]
我叫瑪麗亞·斯普羅多夫斯卡，大家叫我瑪麗亞。
我在幫助像你這樣想成為巫師的小傢伙。

scripts.text:
[Dog called 'Maria']
The reason I became a dog is...My boyfriend that was experimenting to prepare for the Magic Degree, accidentally turned me into a dog.
Theoretically, in a couple months, the chemicals should wear off and I should be returned to normal. Exactly when, I have no idea?
scripts.translation:
[名叫“瑪麗亞”的狗]
我為什麼變成狗...男朋友為了取得魔法學位在做實驗，結果不小心把我變成了狗。
理論上，過幾個月藥效消退，就能恢復原樣。
具體什麼時候，我也不知道。

scripts.text:
[Dog called 'Maria']
I'm not a 'dog' called 'Maria'!! Oi!! Listen to me!!
scripts.translation:
[名叫“瑪麗亞”的狗]
我不是叫“瑪麗亞”的“狗”！！喂！！聽我說！！

scripts.text:
[Maria]
...*BARK* *BARK* *BARK*... I'm upset, but whatever!! You seem busy so I'll just drop it.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
...*汪* *汪* *汪*...氣死我了，不過算了！！
看你好像很忙，不計較了。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
Like I said before, to change jobs, talk to Catherine.
She's a new Wizard too.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
剛才說過，想轉職就去找凱瑟琳。
她也是剛成為巫師的。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
I can tell you more about the job change process, but I can't hold back a busy person now can I?
What do you think? Should I explain some about whats in store for Mages that wish to become Wizards?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
我可以再說明轉職流程，不過也不能耽誤大忙人的時間，是吧？
怎麼樣，要聽聽魔法師成為巫師要經歷什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, please! I would like that.
scripts.translation: 好，請告訴我！

scripts.text: No, it's ok.
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text: A talking dog...
scripts.translation: 一隻會說話的狗...

scripts.text:
[Maria]
OK, I will explain the process for you.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
好，我來說明轉職流程。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
There are three tests in the job change process.
The first test is collecting magic items.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
轉職有三項測試。
第一項是收集魔法物品。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
That one begins when you submit an application to Catherine.
She'll either tell you to collect all types of gemstones, or gather stones with attributes.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
向凱瑟琳提交申請後，就會開始第一項測試。
她會讓你收集各色魔力礦石，或者各屬性的原石。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
Second test is a magic quiz,
The gloomy Laurel in the corner is in charge of that part.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
第二項是魔法知識測驗，由角落裡那個陰沉的勞雷爾負責。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
There are questions about magic, monsters, and Mages.
Out of the 10 questions, if you don't get them all correct, he doesn't let you pass. In other words, you fail...
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
題目涉及魔法、魔物和魔法師。
10道題必須全部答對，他才讓你通過。
也就是說，錯了就不及格...

scripts.text:
[Maria]
Oddly enough, He is in charge of the 3rd test too.
The third test is eliminating monsters.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
奇怪的是，他也負責第三項測試。
第三項測試是消滅魔物。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
In each room, there are monsters of certain attributes.
You must attack them with the appropriate spells.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
每個房間裡都有特定屬性的魔物。
你必須用相應的法術攻擊它們。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
Well, that's all that I can say. Go apply now.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
嗯，我能說的就這些了。現在去申請吧。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
It's better to just try it yourself than to listen to my descriptions.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
與其聽我描述，不如親自去試試。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
Really? Ok, then go apply and do your best.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
真的嗎？好吧，那就去申請吧，加油。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
I'm not a DOG!! HOOOOWWWWWWLLLLLLL~
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
我不是狗！！HOOOOWWWWWWLLLLLLL~

scripts.text:
[Maria]
Dang it! I hope you FAIL!! Go get lost!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
該死！祝你考試失敗！！快滾！

scripts.text:
[Maria]
You seem lost...
You've applied, and now you're looking for the items right?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
你看起來有點迷茫...
你已經申請了，現在是在找材料對吧？

scripts.text:
[Maria]
But since this is only the first test, don't depend on others.
Complete it yourself. Thats the best way.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
不過這只是第一項測試，不要依賴別人。
靠自己完成才是最好的方式。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
From what I've heard, you have to gather gemstones...
I can't help you directly, but I can give you some advice.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
聽說你要收集魔力礦石...
我沒法直接幫忙，不過可以給點建議。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
First, to get Red Gemstones, go to Culverts in Prontera.
You can obtain them from the Thief Bugs and Thief Bug eggs found plentiful there.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
首先，要獲得紅色魔力礦石，去普隆德拉的下水道。
那裡有很多浮勒盜蟲和盜蟲卵，可以從它們身上獲得。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
Yellow Gemstones are easy to find in the desert.
Condors, Picky's, and sometimes monsters like Golem's drop them.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
黃色魔力礦石在沙漠裡很容易找到。
禿鷹、小雞，有時還有巨石怪等魔物會掉落它們。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
And...*woof* to get Blue Gemstones. Try going to the Byalan Dungeons.
Cornutus, Vadon, and monsters like Mars can drop those Gems.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
還有...*汪*想找藍色魔力礦石，就去拜蘭地下城。
卡那多斯、螃蟹，還有瑪爾斯這類魔物，會掉落這些礦石。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
Of course you can get blue Gemstones at the magic shop here in town...
But, finding them yourself would be much more rewarding and helpful later in the test.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
當然，你也可以在鎮上的魔法商店買到藍色魔力礦石...
但自己找到它們會更有成就感，對後面的測試也更有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
Anyways, try your best.
This is the basics of being a Wizard.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
總之，加油吧。
這是成為巫師的基本功。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
You seem lost...
You've applied, and now you're looking for the items right?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
你看起來有點迷茫...
你已經申請了，現在是在找材料對吧？

scripts.text:
[Maria]
But since this is only the first test, don't depend on others for help.
Complete it yourself, thats the best way.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
不過這只是第一項測試，不要依賴別人的幫助。
靠自己完成才是最好的方式。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
From what I've heard, you have to gather elemental stones...
I can't help you directly, but I can give you some advice.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
聽說你要收集屬性原石...
我沒法直接幫忙，不過可以給點建議。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
Well, you can find the Crystal Blue in Byalan Dungeon.
Cornutus, Kukre, Marina, Vadon...these monsters drop them frequently.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
水靈原石可以在拜蘭地下城找到。
卡那多斯、庫克雷、水母、螃蟹...這些魔物經常掉落。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
You can get Green Live from insect type monsters.
Try hunting monsters like Horn, Mantis, or Vitata.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
土靈原石可以從昆蟲系魔物身上獲得。
去打鍬形蟲、螳螂或黑蟻試試。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
Oh and *woof*, Red Blood. I heard you can get a lot of those from...
Elder Willows, Metallers or Scorpions found in the desert would work well too.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
哦，還有*汪*火靈原石。
聽說長老樹精、重金屬蝗蟲會掉落不少，沙漠裡的蠍子也不錯。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
For Wind of Verdue. Hornet, Stainer, Steel Chonchon.
If you try just a bit, you can get them really easily.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
至於風靈原石，可以去打蜂兵、瓢蟲或綠蒼蠅。
稍微花點工夫，就能輕鬆收集到。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
But anyways, always try your best.
It's the basics of being a Wizard.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
但無論如何，都要盡力而為。
這是成為巫師的基本功。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
Don't be too relieved just after the first test.
Try your best, as you still have two more tests to go.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
剛通過第一項測試不要太放鬆。
加油，你還有兩項測試要參加。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
ZzzzZzzzZzzz...
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
ZzzzZzzzZzzz...

scripts.text:
[Maria]
*wimper*...Blizadris...you suck...Zzz...
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
*嗚咽*...布利扎德里斯...你真差勁...Zzz...

scripts.text:
[Maria]
Oh, you're doing well aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
哦，你做得不錯嘛？

scripts.text:
[Maria]
Well, try your best to the very end.
Laurel is waiting.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
好，堅持到最後。
勞雷爾在等你。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
*BARK*...you gave up?
*Sigh*...How can you become a Wizard with such a weak heart?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
*汪汪*...你放棄了？
*嘆氣*...這麼膽小，怎麼能成為巫師呢？

scripts.text:
[Maria]
You know that each room has monsters of the same attribute...
If you're a person that deals with magic, you need to know about the different spells.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
你也知道，每個房間裡的魔物都是同一種屬性...
既然使用魔法，就得了解不同的法術。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
You also need to learn how to counter monsters that use skills.
Your best bet is to kill the monsters that are attacking you first.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
你還需要學會如何應對使用技能的魔物。
最好的辦法是先殺掉正在攻擊你的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
*Grrr* Anyways, continue the test.
Don't have a weak mind, *woof* and go back! *Bark* *Bark* Right this moment! *BARK*
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
*低吼*總之，繼續測試。
別輕易退縮，*汪*回去！*汪* *汪*現在就去！*汪*

scripts.text:
[Maria]
As I thought, I knew you'd be able to do it, I could smell it in yah! *Woof*
Now I can call you Wizard.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
果然，我就知道你能做到，我早就從你身上聞出來了！*汪*
現在，可以叫你巫師了。

scripts.text:
[Maria]
Congratulations. Always give your best at everything, no matter what.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞]
恭喜。無論做什麼，都要全力以赴。
